messages:
Alyssa (Docs): Quick check — opening a small docs PR to add sharding examples for lyra-embed-8b. Found a stale link in the model card. Anyone free to review?

Mike (ML): Which link?

Alyssa (Docs): Points to /docs/embeddings/sharding (404). The guide moved to /guides/embeddings/sharding.

Sophia (SDK): I can fix the snippet too — it uses old .embed() shape. New Node example should use embeddings.create. I'll push a change.

Samir (Eng): Heads-up: hosted runtime exposes an internal X-Embed-Shard header for tests; please don't recommend it in docs. Show client-side hashing instead.

Sophia (SDK): Will do. Draft snippet: ```js
// shard inputs client-side
const shards = shardInputs(inputs, 4);
await Promise.all(shards.map(s => client.embeddings.create({ model: 'lyra-embed-8b', input: s })));
```

Mike (ML): Also note sequence limits: quantized-8bit variant behaves oddly past 8192 tokens — best-effort truncate and quality may drop. Add a short caveat in the model card.

Alyssa (Docs): Good call. I'll add: "sequence_limit: 8192 (quantized-8bit: best-effort truncation; quality may degrade near boundary)."

DocsBot: PR #4123 CI: embed smoke tests flagged single-input >8192 failure on quantized variant.

Samir (Eng): Filed infra redirect for old slug /models/lyra -> /catalog/models/lyra-embed-8b. Will deploy a 301.

Alyssa (Docs): Thanks — I'll wait for the redirect before merging so external links don't break.

Samir (Eng): Redirect live.

Alyssa (Docs): CI green after SDK tweak, merged PR #4123. Added short throughput note: "Sharding increases throughput but adds per-shard overhead; batch when latency matters." Closing.

Sophia (SDK): I'll add a release-note blurb about the snippet change.

Mike (ML): I'll track quality around the 8k boundary.

Alyssa (Docs): Thanks all!
